claim: If an application accesses data infrequently or reads a wide range of rarely reused (cold) data, it will likely see a low DAX cache hit ratio, and the overhead of maintaining the cache might not justify the performance gains.

evidence.quote: **Infrequently read data** – If your application accesses data infrequently or a wide range of rarely reused data (cold data), you'll likely experience a low [cache hit ratio](pres-guide-monitor-dax.md#cachehitratio).
In this case, the overhead of maintaining the cache might not justify the performance gains.
